moments.title: The Origin Story of DeepInfra
moments.insight: Founder explains how they started DeepInfra in 2022 after noticing AI models need hundreds of billions of computations per token, drawing on experience scaling a messaging app to 200M+ users.

moments.title: B200 GPUs at $275 vs $6-10 on Hyperscalers
moments.insight: DeepInfra offers Nvidia B200 GPUs at $275 compared to $6-10+ on major public clouds like AWS and Azure.

moments.title: Pricing a Model at 27¢ When Rivals Charged 60¢
moments.insight: DeepInfra aggressively priced Mistral's mixture-of-experts model at 27 cents per million tokens while competitors charged 60 cents, based on correctly costing only the active experts used at runtime.

moments.title: Why Inference Isn't Like High-Frequency Trading
moments.insight: Unlike HFT which needs proximity to exchanges, inference is so power-hungry that GPUs are best placed in rural areas near cheap electricity rather than near users for latency.

moments.title: Open Source Models Are Catching Up Fast
moments.insight: The founder says with models like Kimi 2.6 and DeepSeek 4, the gap between open and closed frontier models has nearly disappeared compared to the huge gap seen with Llama 2 vs GPT-4.

moments.title: The Server Depreciation Myth in AI Infrastructure
moments.insight: Drawing from a decade running data centers, he argues old GPUs like A100s and H100s remain fully utilized and even command higher prices due to overwhelming demand, defying assumptions about rapid obs
